progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs4 and dwells most on Fs in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:26.1) introduces Fs, Gk, Dk, centred on Fs. Phrase 4 (0:54.7) introduces Ab, centred on Fs. Phrase 6 (1:23.6) introduces Gs, Bb, Bk, centred on Fs. The line peaks at D5 (577.5 Hz) at 0:49.4. It closes on Fs3, not the tonic (Cs3 → Ab4 → Ab4 → Ek4 → Bk4 → Fs3).
